title: 3v2 with pass minimum
setup: Two small goals 20 yards apart. Three lines on one side, two lines on the other.
instructions: Three-player side starts with the ball. The must complete some number (3-5, coaches choice) of passes before scoring. Defense may score at any time.
Minimum pass number applies any time the three-player team gains possession.
coachingPoints: Complete the minimum number of passes (3-5, coaches choice) before the three-player team scores.
